plan.title: Live RFQ Shared With Participation Summary

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ directly on its Responses tab.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the requested live-event withdrawal configuration.
Open Shared With from the RFQ Settings menu without pressing any action in the resulting summary.
Verify that the Participation Summary window opened.
Verify the invited count shown in the summary.
Verify the seen count shown in the summary.
Verify the bid-placed count shown in the summary.
Verify the bid-not-placed count shown in the summary.
Verify the unregistered POC bids count shown in the summary.
Verify that the Notify button is available and that no notification action was pressed.
